title: 集光式太陽能定日鏡校準
summary: 塔式電廠的定日鏡必須把陽光反射到一公里外、只有十幾公尺寬的吸熱器上，角度誤差要控制在千分之一弧度上下；安裝誤差、基礎沉陷與機構背隙使每一面鏡子都必須個別校準。課程以阿爾梅里亞太陽能平台的試驗鏡場為背景，定量分析太陽圓盤造成的最小光斑、各項誤差的合成、吸熱器的截取率、餘弦效率、編碼器解析度與全場校準所需的時間。
summaryEn: Heliostats of a tower plant must reflect sunlight onto a receiver ten-odd metres wide a kilometre away, with angular error held near a thousandth of a radian; installation error, foundation settlement and backlash mean every mirror needs calibrating individually. Set against the test fields of the Plataforma Solar de Almería, the course quantifies minimum spot size from the solar disc, combination of errors, receiver intercept, cosine efficiency, encoder resolution and the time to calibrate a whole field.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 讓一萬面鏡子都打中同一個目標：太陽圓盤、誤差合成、截取率與校準時間
v30FocusEn: Making ten thousand mirrors all hit one target: the solar disc, combining errors, intercept and calibration time

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：集光式太陽能定日鏡校準
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field aperture and annual energy" and "The solar disc and the smallest spot": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field aperture and annual energy" is correct?
options: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。
陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。
平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。
optionsEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust.
On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels.
A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes.
quiz.explanation: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「鏡場面積與年發電量」如何決定「集光式太陽能定日鏡校準」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field aperture and annual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：太陽圓盤的視角半徑約 4.65 mrad
steps.observationEn: Project file: The angular radius of the solar disc is about 4.65 mrad
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「鏡場面積與年發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Field aperture and annual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案

quiz.question: 依「鏡場面積與年發電量」的模型 E = DNI·A·η_se，鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = DNI·A·η_se for "Field aperture and annual energy", which value is closest to the annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)?
options: 240 GWh
480 GWh
optionsEn: 240 GWh
480 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡場面積與年發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Field aperture and annual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etase 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etase by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 528 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 528 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 480 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etase 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 480 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etase with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 528 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 528 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field aperture and annual energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
定日鏡放在塔的哪一邊，效果都一樣。
以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A heliostat works equally well on any side of the tower.
Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.
quiz.explanation: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field aperture and annual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
knowledge.textEn: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62862 太陽熱發電廠標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62862 series on solar thermal electric plants. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「鏡場面積與年發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field aperture and annual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。
optionsEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes.
quiz.explanation: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡場面積與年發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Field aperture and annual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「集光式太陽能定日鏡校準」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 1981：阿爾梅里亞的試驗鏡場開始運轉

quiz.question: 關於「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The solar disc and the smallest spot" is correct?
options: 平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。
各項誤差直接加起來就是總誤差。
太陽不是一個點。
optionsEn: A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes.
Adding the individual errors gives the total error.
The sun is not a point.
quiz.explanation: 太陽不是一個點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The sun is not a point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 太陽圓盤與最小光斑：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: The solar disc and the smallest spot: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」如何決定「集光式太陽能定日鏡校準」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The solar disc and the smallest spot” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 太陽不是一個點。從地球上看，它是一個直徑約半度的圓盤；所以即使是一面完美的平面鏡，反射出去的也不是平行光，而是一個以同樣角度張開的光錐。光錐到了一公里外，直徑已經將近十公尺。這是光斑大小的物理下限，再好的鏡子也無法突破。離塔越遠的定日鏡，光斑越大、打到吸熱器外面的比例越高；這限制了鏡場的最大半徑，也是大型電廠必須把塔蓋得很高、吸熱器做得很大的原因。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The sun is not a point. Seen from Earth it is a disc about half a degree across, so even a perfect flat mirror reflects not parallel light but a cone opening at that angle. A kilometre away the cone is nearly ten metres across. That is the physical floor on spot size which no mirror can beat. The farther a heliostat from the tower, the larger its spot and the more misses the receiver, limiting maximum field radius and explaining why large plants need very tall towers and large receivers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：商用定日鏡的追蹤誤差要求通常在 1 mrad 上下
steps.observationEn: Project file: Tracking error required of commercial heliostats is typically around 1 mrad
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “The solar disc and the smallest spot”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 太陽圓盤與最小光斑
knowledge.titleEn: The solar disc and the smallest spot
knowledge.text: 太陽不是一個點。從地球上看，它是一個直徑約半度的圓盤；所以即使是一面完美的平面鏡，反射出去的也不是平行光，而是一個以同樣角度張開的光錐。光錐到了一公里外，直徑已經將近十公尺。這是光斑大小的物理下限，再好的鏡子也無法突破。離塔越遠的定日鏡，光斑越大、打到吸熱器外面的比例越高；這限制了鏡場的最大半徑，也是大型電廠必須把塔蓋得很高、吸熱器做得很大的原因。
knowledge.textEn: The sun is not a point. Seen from Earth it is a disc about half a degree across, so even a perfect flat mirror reflects not parallel light but a cone opening at that angle. A kilometre away the cone is nearly ten metres across. That is the physical floor on spot size which no mirror can beat. The farther a heliostat from the tower, the larger its spot and the more misses the receiver, limiting maximum field radius and explaining why large plants need very tall towers and large receivers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 商用定日鏡的追蹤誤差要求通常在 1 mrad 上下
knowledge.textEn: Tracking error required of commercial heliostats is typically around 1 mrad

quiz.question: 依「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」的模型 d = 2·θ_s·L，太陽視角半徑 4.65 mrad、距離 1,000 m 時理想鏡面的光斑直徑最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model d = 2·θ_s·L for "The solar disc and the smallest spot", which value is closest to the spot diameter from an ideal mirror at 1,000 m for a solar angular radius of 4.65 mrad?
quiz.explanation: d = 2·θ_s·L；代入 θ = 4.65 mrad、L = 1000 m，得 9.3 m（太陽視角半徑 4.65 mrad、距離 1,000 m 時理想鏡面的光斑直徑）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: d = 2·θ_s·L; with θ = 4.65 mrad, L = 1000 m the result is 9.3 m (spot diameter from an ideal mirror at 1,000 m for a solar angular radius of 4.65 mrad). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 太陽圓盤與最小光斑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The solar disc and the smallest spot: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “The solar disc and the smallest spot” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：d = 2·θ_s·L；代入 θ = 4.65 mrad、L = 1000 m，得 9.3 m（太陽視角半徑 4.65 mrad、距離 1,000 m 時理想鏡面的光斑直徑）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 L 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: d = 2·θ_s·L; with θ = 4.65 mrad, L = 1000 m the result is 9.3 m (spot diameter from an ideal mirror at 1,000 m for a solar angular radius of 4.65 mrad). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise L by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：L 增加 10% 時，結果變為 10.2 m（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising L by 10% changes the result to 10.2 m (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 9.3 m（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 L 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 9.3 m (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in L with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: d = 2·θ_s·L；代入 θ = 4.65 mrad、L = 1000 m，得 9.3 m（太陽視角半徑 4.65 mrad、距離 1,000 m 時理想鏡面的光斑直徑）。
knowledge.textEn: d = 2·θ_s·L; with θ = 4.65 mrad, L = 1000 m the result is 9.3 m (spot diameter from an ideal mirror at 1,000 m for a solar angular radius of 4.65 mrad).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: L 增加 10% 時，結果變為 10.2 m（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising L by 10% changes the result to 10.2 m (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The solar disc and the smallest spot"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把單面定日鏡的光斑打在塔上的白色標靶上，以相機量測它的大小與形狀並和理論值比較。
電腦算出來的角度，鏡子就一定轉到那個角度。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
The spot of a single heliostat is cast on a white target on the tower, and a camera measures its size and shape against theory.
A mirror always turns exactly to the angle the computer calculates.
quiz.explanation: 把單面定日鏡的光斑打在塔上的白色標靶上，以相機量測它的大小與形狀並和理論值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The spot of a single heliostat is cast on a white target on the tower, and a camera measures its size and shape against theory. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 太陽圓盤與最小光斑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The solar disc and the smallest spot: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “The solar disc and the smallest spot” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把單面定日鏡的光斑打在塔上的白色標靶上，以相機量測它的大小與形狀並和理論值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The spot of a single heliostat is cast on a white target on the tower, and a camera measures its size and shape against theory. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鏡場的佈置要以含太陽形狀的光學模擬決定最遠距離，遠處的定日鏡採用聚焦的曲面鏡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set maximum distance in field layout by optical simulation including sun shape, with focusing curved facets on distant heliostats.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大氣中的氣膠使太陽周圍出現光暈，實際的光源比圓盤更寬；沙塵天時遠處定日鏡的光斑明顯擴大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aerosols in the air put an aureole round the sun so the real source is wider than the disc, and on dusty days spots from distant heliostats grow markedly. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把單面定日鏡的光斑打在塔上的白色標靶上，以相機量測它的大小與形狀並和理論值比較。
knowledge.textEn: The spot of a single heliostat is cast on a white target on the tower, and a camera measures its size and shape against theory.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鏡場的佈置要以含太陽形狀的光學模擬決定最遠距離，遠處的定日鏡採用聚焦的曲面鏡。
knowledge.textEn: Set maximum distance in field layout by optical simulation including sun shape, with focusing curved facets on distant heliostats.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：SolarPACES 定日鏡與反射鏡量測指引。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: SolarPACES guidelines for heliostat and reflectance measurement. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The solar disc and the smallest spot" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
各項誤差直接加起來就是總誤差。
大氣中的氣膠使太陽周圍出現光暈，實際的光源比圓盤更寬；沙塵天時遠處定日鏡的光斑明顯擴大。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Adding the individual errors gives the total error.
Aerosols in the air put an aureole round the sun so the real source is wider than the disc, and on dusty days spots from distant heliostats grow markedly.
quiz.explanation: 大氣中的氣膠使太陽周圍出現光暈，實際的光源比圓盤更寬；沙塵天時遠處定日鏡的光斑明顯擴大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aerosols in the air put an aureole round the sun so the real source is wider than the disc, and on dusty days spots from distant heliostats grow markedly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 太陽圓盤與最小光斑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The solar disc and the smallest spot: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「太陽圓盤與最小光斑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “The solar disc and the smallest spot” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大氣中的氣膠使太陽周圍出現光暈，實際的光源比圓盤更寬；沙塵天時遠處定日鏡的光斑明顯擴大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「集光式太陽能定日鏡校準」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Aerosols in the air put an aureole round the sun so the real source is wider than the disc, and on dusty days spots from distant heliostats grow markedly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：離塔越遠的定日鏡，光斑越大、打到吸熱器外面的比例越高；這限制了鏡場的最大半徑，也是大型電廠必須把塔蓋得很高、吸熱器做得很大的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The farther a heliostat from the tower, the larger its spot and the more misses the receiver, limiting maximum field radius and explaining why large plants need very tall towers and large receivers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面鏡反射的光束走多遠都一樣粗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A beam from a flat mirror stays the same width however far it goes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大氣中的氣膠使太陽周圍出現光暈，實際的光源比圓盤更寬；沙塵天時遠處定日鏡的光斑明顯擴大。
knowledge.textEn: Aerosols in the air put an aureole round the sun so the real source is wider than the disc, and on dusty days spots from distant heliostats grow markedly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
